description: Runs Anthropic skill-creator eval loop for a skill (requires Python, Claude CLI auth, and an eval set JSON; legacy layouts may also require ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + anthropic package).

description_override.description: Optional starting description override for what-if optimization without editing SKILL.md first

eval_set_path.description: Optional path to eval set JSON. If omitted, common default locations are checked.

holdout.description: Optional holdout fraction for run_loop test split (defaults to 0.4, use 0 to disable holdout)

model.description: Optional model passed to Claude CLI (defaults to "sonnet")

num_workers.description: Optional evaluator parallel workers (defaults to 1 for stable trigger measurements)

runs_per_query.description: Optional repeats per query (defaults to 1; increase for variance analysis)

skill_name.description: The skill directory name to evaluate

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout per query in seconds (defaults to 120)

trigger_threshold.description: Optional trigger-rate threshold for pass/fail decisions (defaults to 0.5)

name: evaluate_skill
